purpose: Product contract for non-match UI settings, daily chat memory, and postgame review memory used by the runtime coach.

rank_tier.strategy_effect: Adjust risk tolerance, explanation granularity, and operational assumptions. The live-ranking segment is always master_plus for every user preference; lower user ranks should still receive more robust top-four guidance unless the user says otherwise.
rank_tier.fallback_policy: Historical challenger preferences normalize to master. If master_plus evidence is unavailable, expose that absence explicitly and do not silently mix in platinum_to_diamond or all-tier evidence.

operation_speed.strategy_effect: Controls whether the coach recommends same-round large pivots, one-round-ahead preparation, or only small changes during action phases.

default_goal.strategy_effect: Long-term preference that biases cruise advice, but current match live_state and user messages can override it.

diagnostic_evidence_enabled.behavior: When enabled, retain bounded OCR and Host diagnostic evidence for troubleshooting. Diagnostic persistence must run after canonical work, never delay answer delivery, and expire after seven days.

daily_chat_mode.purpose: General chat, preference capture, and review discussion outside an active match.
daily_chat_mode.memory_write_policy: The agent may suggest memory updates, but durable user_memory writes require user approval.

postgame_review_mode.purpose: Review recent match decisions, identify recurring mistakes, and update user-approved learning notes.

runtime_policy.active_match_restriction: daily_chat and postgame_review may be opened only when no active match is running or after Stop Match. During active match, user chat is routed into cruise mode or the active task mode.
runtime_policy.pollution_guard: Recent match summaries and user memory can bias strategy, but previous-match concrete board/shop/economy facts must not be copied into a new match live_state.
